decisions.title: ai-trace lint: two-tier patterns — strong tokens anywhere, weak patterns comment lines only
decisions.rationale: bare W-numbers flood false positives on assertion labels in string literals (T55 'W1 clean rc'); comment-line scoping keeps the weak-form recurrence vector covered without drowning functional strings
decisions.birth_phase: P6: comment hygiene and coding standards

decisions.title: ai-trace exemptions: path carve-outs (.changes.md/CHANGELOG/.gos) + categorized cjk-style whitelist
decisions.rationale: test Covers headers have no tool consumer; .gos/codebase is the anchor knowledge layer by design; T46 drift ledger goes under a whitelist category, not a convention rewrite
decisions.birth_phase: P6: comment hygiene and coding standards

decisions.title: migration: whitelist-as-tracker, lint blocking day one, per-path maxHits caps
decisions.rationale: cjk-lint-verified homolog: anchors beyond the cap fail immediately, swept batches remove entries, whitelist size is machine-visible remaining debt
decisions.birth_phase: P6: comment hygiene and coding standards

decisions.title: sweep disposition: three-way per-line judgment — strip-anchor-keep-WHAT / delete-with-changelog-backfill / whitelist
decisions.rationale: zero information loss, matches the AGENTS.md comment policy; codemod comment-lines-only with immediate grep assertion (96615604), affected sections per batch
decisions.birth_phase: P6: comment hygiene and coding standards

decisions.title: seeding entry: gos init coding stays the single master; setup onboarding gains one hint line (locale key pair)
decisions.rationale: seeding is fully delivered and T69-tested; the only real gap is discoverability; a wizard step would need an unlisted cross-domain require (ops->task) — cost overruns the benefit
decisions.birth_phase: P6: comment hygiene and coding standards

decisions.title: product-side: literal scope — self-repo lint covers templates/; books gain missing anchor forms
decisions.rationale: phase text applies the lint TO the assets; templates are already clean and stay covered; cjk-lint self-repo-only precedent holds; shipping the capability to user repos goes to deferred ideas
decisions.birth_phase: P6: comment hygiene and coding standards

decisions.title: pattern set is census-first: lint ships --emit-baseline generating the landing whitelist from its own final patterns
decisions.rationale: three rounds independently proved hand census wrong (42 vs 87 files, bracket-only vs dominant bare forms); whitelist==lint-output invariant, regen guard rejects hand edits
decisions.birth_phase: P6: comment hygiene and coding standards

decisions.title: counts are exact-equality maxHits (actual==maxHits); bare Wave N demoted to tier B; plan-format lines exempt
decisions.rationale: equality kills stale-cap slack for free; Wave N is the product's own plan.md syntax (templates+fixtures+skills examples) and can never be swept
decisions.birth_phase: P6: comment hygiene and coding standards

decisions.title: backfill target is CHANGELOG.md [Unreleased]; teaching docs use placeholder spellings
decisions.rationale: .changes.md is SEALED (R3-F5); books' [REVIEW M1] examples are real tier-A hits so teaching uses digit-free placeholders; frozen-string + lint-fixture categories added (R3-F4/R2-F5)

decisions.title: sweep harness mechanizes batch discipline: allowed-line-set, diff guard, CHANGELOG reconciliation, serial main-session
decisions.rationale: four text-only constraints had no verification path (R1-F4/R3-F6); the harness is the sole legal consumer of lint --json output
decisions.birth_phase: P6: comment hygiene and coding standards
